title: External validation and clinical implementation of clinical prediction models: a systematic review.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To assess whether external validation and clinical implementation of clinical prediction models reflect sequential or distinct stages of a translational pathway. This cross-sectional meta-epidemiologic study analyzed 1072 machine learning-based clinical prediction models published across clinical domains (2017-2019). We assessed downstream external validation and clinical implementation via citation screening through August 2025. Evaluated exposures included public code availability, TRIPOD adherence, multicenter design, and sample size. Secondary outcomes included investigator overlap. Among 1072 studies, 88.1% lacked translational follow-up. Only 9.9% underwent external validation, and 5.2% reached clinical implementation. Code availability (odds ratio [OR] 3.04; 95% CI, 1.91-4.84) and higher TRIPOD adherence (OR 2.68 per 10% increase; 95% CI, 2.04-3.52) were significantly associated with external validation, but not consistently with clinical implementation. Notably, 39% of implemented models lacked prior external validation. Independent groups predominantly conducted external validation (72.6%), whereas implementation frequently involved original development teams. Findings indicate a divergence in algorithmic translation. Characteristics emphasizing evaluability (code availability, reporting transparency) facilitate external validation but do not ensure clinical implementation. The frequent bypass of independent validation before implementation highlights a reliance on institutional and operational factors rather than generalizable methodology. External validation and clinical implementation appear to represent distinct translational processes rather than sequential stages influenced by a uniform set of factors. Current practices facilitate validation but inadequately address operational requirements for real-world deployment.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 旨在评估临床预测模型的外部验证与临床实施，是反映转化路径的先后阶段，还是相互独立的不同阶段。这项横断面元流行病学研究分析了2017—2019年间发表于各临床领域的1072个基于机器学习的临床预测模型。我们通过截至2025年8月的引文筛查，评估其后续的外部验证和临床实施情况。评估的暴露因素包括公开代码的可获得性、TRIPOD依从性、多中心设计和样本量。次要结局包括研究者重叠情况。在1072项研究中，88.1%缺乏转化后续。仅9.9%进行了外部验证，5.2%达到临床实施。代码可获得性（比值比[OR] 3.04；95% CI，1.91–4.84）和更高的TRIPOD依从性（每提高10%，OR 2.68；95% CI，2.04–3.52）与外部验证显著相关，但与临床实施的相关性并不一致。值得注意的是，39%已实施的模型此前未经外部验证。外部验证主要由独立团队开展（72.6%），而临床实施则常有原始开发团队参与。研究结果表明算法转化存在分化。强调可评估性的特征（代码可获得性、报告透明度）有利于外部验证，但并不能保证临床实施。实施前频繁绕过独立验证，凸显出对机构因素和运营因素而非可推广方法学的依赖。外部验证与临床实施似乎代表不同的转化过程，而非受同一组因素影响的先后阶段。当前的做法有利于验证，但未能充分满足真实世界部署的运营需求。

source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] We audited deployment readiness of an end-of-surgery postoperative infection model across clinically relevant subgroups and assessed mitigation of subgroup miscalibration. We analyzed out-of-fold predictions from 10 719 procedures (2014-2022) with 504 present-on-admission (POA)-coded postoperative infection events across recorded sex, age, and a clinical physiological-reserve proxy. We assessed discrimination, calibration, threshold-specific errors, and decision-curve net benefit, treating t = 0.10 as a reference anchor. We compared no recalibration with common and group-specific cross-fitted isotonic recalibration, evaluated a refit without the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE), and performed a temporal-holdout analysis. Overall area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.876, with similar sex-marginal discrimination in women and men (0.878 vs 0.875). Calibration-in-the-large was -1.02 overall, -0.86 in frail, and -1.34 in prefrail patients; the 6-event nonfrail stratum was not estimable. At t = 0.10, net benefit was positive in frail and negative in prefrail patients in the source cohort, but negative prefrail utility did not persist in the ascertainable-period (2018-2022) and temporal analyses. Common recalibration moved overall calibration-in-the-large from -1.020 to -0.007. Removing SMOTE shifted overall calibration but did not reduce the reserve gradient. Temporal-holdout AUROC was 0.851 with persistent overprediction. Present-on-admission coding was effectively absent before 2018; prevalence-dependent results were therefore additionally reported for the ascertainable 2018-2022 period, and ascertainment differed by physiological reserve. Discrimination-only or sex-marginal evaluation would have missed deployment-relevant subgroup heterogeneity, while endpoint ascertainment affected prevalence-dependent interpretation. Joint subgroup evaluation can identify deployment-relevant limitations missed by aggregate metrics. Prospective validation with comparable outcome ascertainment remains necessary before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 我们审核了一种术毕术后感染预测模型在临床相关亚组中的部署就绪程度，并评估了亚组校准偏差的缓解方法。我们分析了10 719例手术（2014–2022年）的折外预测结果，其中包含504例入院时存在（POA）编码的术后感染事件，并按记录的性别、年龄以及一项临床生理储备代理指标进行分析。我们评估了区分度、校准度、特定阈值下的错误率以及决策曲线净获益，并将 t = 0.10 作为参考锚点。我们比较了不进行重新校准、通用的以及分组特异性的交叉拟合保序重新校准，评估了不使用合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）的重新拟合，并进行了时间留出分析。总体受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.876，女性与男性按性别边际计算的区分度相近（0.878 对 0.875）。总体的整体校准（calibration-in-the-large）为 -1.02，衰弱患者为 -0.86，衰弱前期患者为 -1.34；仅有6例事件的非衰弱层无法估计。在 t = 0.10 时，源队列中衰弱患者的净获益为正，衰弱前期患者为负，但衰弱前期的负效用在可确证期（2018–2022年）分析和时间分析中并未持续存在。通用重新校准使总体整体校准从 -1.020 变为 -0.007。去除SMOTE改变了总体校准，但未减小生理储备梯度。时间留出AUROC为0.851，且持续存在高估。2018年之前入院时存在编码实际上缺失；因此，对依赖患病率的结果另行报告了可确证的2018–2022年期间，并且不同生理储备患者的事件确证情况存在差异。仅评估区分度或按性别边际评估会遗漏与部署相关的亚组异质性，而终点确证情况影响了对依赖患病率结果的解读。联合亚组评估可以发现被汇总指标遗漏的与部署相关的局限性。在临床部署之前，仍需在结局确证方式可比的条件下进行前瞻性验证。

source: PubMed · Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences

abstract: [Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences] Seed implant brachytherapy (SIBT) is an effective cancer treatment modality; however, clinical planning often relies on manual adjustment of objective function weights, leading to inefficiencies and suboptimal results. This study proposes an adaptive weight optimization framework for SIBT planning, driven by large language models (LLMs). A locally deployed DeepSeek-R1 LLM is integrated with an automatic planning algorithm in an iterative loop. Starting with fixed weights, the LLM evaluates plan quality and recommends new weights in the next iteration. This process continues until convergence criteria are met, after which the LLM conducts a comprehensive evaluation to identify the optimal plan. A clinical knowledge base, constructed and queried via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enhances the model's domain-specific reasoning. The proposed method was retrospectively validated on 23 patient cases who underwent head-and-neck SIBT, showing that the LLM-assisted approach maintained clinical target volume (CTV) coverage and reduced excessive target dose relative to fixed-weight planning; in the eight patients with available organs at risk (OARs) contours, OAR dose metrics showed favorable numerical trends. The study demonstrates the potential of LLMs as assistive tools for SIBT planning under clinician supervision.

title: An uncertainty-aware deep learning-based registration model for adaptive lung cancer radiotherapy.
source: PubMed · Physics in medicine and biology

summary: 提出变分贝叶斯框架TM-prob，预测位移场逐体素均值与方差，用于MR引导放疗剂量累积，并与TM-MCD、ASDIR在DIRLAB等数据上对比。

abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] To develop a deep learning (DL) based probabilistic 3D deformable image registration framework for uncertainty-aware dose accumulation in magnetic resonance imaging-guided radiotherapy (MRgRT) of lung cancer. Approach: We propose TransMorph-prob (TM-prob), a variational Bayesian model that predicts the voxel-wise mean and variance of dense displacement fields (DDFs). Two TM-prob models were trained on an internal CT dataset (725 patients) and a low-field MR-linac dataset (102 patients), and benchmarked against Monte Carlo dropout TransMorph (TM-MCD) and DIRUncertainty with B-spline initialization (ASDIR) on the DIRLAB 4DCT dataset (10 patients, 3000 landmarks), and an annotated MR-linac dataset (16 patients, 107 image pairs, 227 landmarks) with target and seven organ-at-risk (OAR) contours. Both datasets contained an additional 1239/13,289 algorithm-generated landmarks. Performance was evaluated using target registration error (TRE), Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), landmark- and voxel-wise expected calibration errors (LECE/ECE), and dose distributions derived from 2000 DDF samples per patient. Main results: On the DIRLAB dataset, TM-prob achieved a median TRE of \qty{1.8}{\mm}/\qty{2.8}{\mm} on manual/algorithm-generated landmarks, versus \qty{1.3}{\mm}/\qty{2.4}{\mm} for ASDIR and \qty{2.1}{\mm}/\qty{3.0}{\mm} for TM-MCD. On the MRI dataset, TM-prob achieved the median TRE of \qty{3.9}{\mm}/\qty{2.6}{\mm} and a mean DSC of 0.87, matching ASDIR (\qty{3.3}{\mm}/\qty{2.7}{\mm}, and DSC of 0.87) while outperforming TM-MCD (\qty{4.4}{\mm}/\qty{2.9}{\mm}, and 0.84). In uncertainty calibration, TM-prob achieved a LECE of \qty{1.74}{\mm}/\qty{0.30}{\mm} on MRI manual/algorithm-generated landmarks versus \qty{2.41}{\mm}/\qty{0.56}{\mm} for ASDIR and \qty{6.65}{\mm}/\qty{3.92}{\mm} for TM-MCD, and an average contour ECE of 5.8% versus 7.0% and 21.2%. Two patients with indistinct GTV boundaries exhibited substantially wider target D95 distributions, demonstrating that calibrated DDF uncertainty translates into clinically relevant dose-coverage uncertainty. Significance: TM-prob is an end-to-end DL model, achieving fast, well-calibrated, uncertainty-aware registration for lung cancer patients, enabling reliable DDF uncertainty propagation into dose accumulation for clinical decision-making in online adaptive radiotherapy.
zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 目的：开发一种基于深度学习（DL）的概率性三维可变形图像配准框架，用于肺癌磁共振成像引导放疗（MRgRT）中考虑不确定性的剂量累积。方法：我们提出TransMorph-prob（TM-prob），这是一种变分贝叶斯模型，可预测密集位移场（DDF）的逐体素均值和方差。在内部CT数据集（725例患者）和低场磁共振直线加速器（MR-linac）数据集（102例患者）上分别训练了两个TM-prob模型，并与蒙特卡洛dropout TransMorph（TM-MCD）以及采用B样条初始化的DIRUncertainty（ASDIR）进行基准比较。比较在DIRLAB 4DCT数据集（10例患者，3000个标志点）和一个带标注的MR-linac数据集（16例患者，107对图像，227个标志点，含靶区及7个危及器官（OAR）轮廓）上进行。两个数据集还分别包含额外的1239/13,289个算法生成的标志点。性能评价采用靶配准误差（TRE）、Dice相似系数（DSC）、基于标志点和基于体素的期望校准误差（LECE/ECE），以及由每位患者2000个DDF样本得出的剂量分布。主要结果：在DIRLAB数据集上，TM-prob对手工/算法生成标志点的TRE中位数为\qty{1.8}{\mm}/\qty{2.8}{\mm}，ASDIR为\qty{1.3}{\mm}/\qty{2.4}{\mm}，TM-MCD为\qty{2.1}{\mm}/\qty{3.0}{\mm}。在MRI数据集上，TM-prob的TRE中位数为\qty{3.9}{\mm}/\qty{2.6}{\mm}，平均DSC为0.87，与ASDIR（\qty{3.3}{\mm}/\qty{2.7}{\mm}，DSC 0.87）相当，且优于TM-MCD（\qty{4.4}{\mm}/\qty{2.9}{\mm}，DSC 0.84）。在不确定性校准方面，TM-prob在MRI手工/算法生成标志点上的LECE为\qty{1.74}{\mm}/\qty{0.30}{\mm}，ASDIR为\qty{2.41}{\mm}/\qty{0.56}{\mm}，TM-MCD为\qty{6.65}{\mm}/\qty{3.92}{\mm}；平均轮廓ECE为5.8%，而ASDIR和TM-MCD分别为7.0%和21.2%。两例GTV边界不清的患者其靶区D95分布明显更宽，表明经过校准的DDF不确定性可转化为具有临床意义的剂量覆盖不确定性。意义：TM-prob是一种端到端DL模型，可为肺癌患者实现快速、校准良好且考虑不确定性的配准，使DDF不确定性能够可靠地传递到剂量累积中，从而为在线自适应放疗的临床决策提供支持。

title: Artificial intelligence-enabled detection of vascular perfusion defects on ventilation/perfusion (V/Q) scintigraphy for pulmonary embolism.
source: PubMed · Physics in medicine and biology

summary: 回顾性纳入2,118例平面V/Q显像患者，评估四种神经网络对灌注缺损的自动分割，并与人工标注者比较。

abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] Accurate interpretation of planar ventilation-perfusion (V/Q) scintigraphy, used for diagnosing pulmonary embolism (PE) based on PIOPED/EANM guidelines, requires objective assessment of mismatched V/Q defects. Manual delineation of V/Q defects is time-consuming, subject to interobserver variability, and rarely performed in practice, limiting standardized reporting and quantification of disease burden. To address these challenges, we evaluated four modern AI models for automated segmentation of vascular perfusion defects in planar V/Q scans and compared their performance to human annotators. We retrospectively identified 2,118 patients who underwent planar V/Q scans at The Ottawa Hospital (June 2019-February 2023). Six standard projections (ANT, POST, LAO, RAO, LPO, RPO) were included. Four 2D neural networks (U-Net, nnU-Net, Swin UNETR, and a Bottleneck Transformer U-Net [BTU-Net]) were trained on 1,313 patients (7,878 projections) and validated on 329 (1,974 projections) using physician-annotated defects. A hold-out test set of 46 high probability patients was used to evaluate segmentation quality, and defect detection accuracy using free-response receiver operating characteristic (FROC) analysis. BTU-Net was the only model performing on par with human readers, showing robust sensitivity across the entire range of segmentation probabilities. At 1.5 false positives per projection rate (FPPR), BTU-Net outperformed other models with sensitivity of 0.529 ± 0.026, On a separate hold-out set of low likelihood of disease patients (n=430), the lowest FPPR was 0.08 ± 0.01 for BTU-Net (P<0.0001). BTU-Net enables rapid, consistent, and accurate interpretation of planar V/Q scans. Such tools may enhance diagnostic efficiency, standardize reporting, and support non-expert readers in evaluating PE.
zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 平面通气-灌注（V/Q）显像用于依据 PIOPED/EANM 指南诊断肺栓塞（PE），其准确解读需要对 V/Q 不匹配缺损进行客观评估。手动勾画 V/Q 缺损耗时、存在观察者间差异，且在实践中很少进行，限制了标准化报告和疾病负担的量化。为应对这些挑战，我们评估了四种现代 AI 模型对平面 V/Q 扫描中血管灌注缺损的自动分割，并将其性能与人工标注者进行比较。我们回顾性纳入了渥太华医院（The Ottawa Hospital）2019 年 6 月至 2023 年 2 月期间接受平面 V/Q 扫描的 2,118 例患者。纳入六个标准投影（ANT、POST、LAO、RAO、LPO、RPO）。四种二维神经网络（U-Net、nnU-Net、Swin UNETR 和 Bottleneck Transformer U-Net [BTU-Net]）在 1,313 例患者（7,878 个投影）上训练，并在 329 例患者（1,974 个投影）上使用医师标注的缺损进行验证。以 46 例高概率患者组成的留出测试集评估分割质量，并采用自由响应受试者工作特征（FROC）分析评估缺损检出准确性。BTU-Net 是唯一表现与人工阅片者相当的模型，在整个分割概率范围内均显示出稳健的敏感度。在每个投影 1.5 个假阳性（FPPR）时，BTU-Net 优于其他模型，敏感度为 0.529 ± 0.026；在另一组疾病低可能性患者的留出集（n=430）上，BTU-Net 的最低 FPPR 为 0.08 ± 0.01（P<0.0001）。BTU-Net 能够对平面 V/Q 扫描进行快速、一致且准确的解读。此类工具可能提高诊断效率、规范报告，并支持非专家阅片者评估 PE。

title: Artificial Intelligence-driven Biomarker Discovery for Precision Psychiatry.
source: PubMed · Clinical psychopharmacology and neuroscience : the official scientific journal of the Korean College of Neuropsychopharmacology

abstract: [Clinical psychopharmacology and neuroscience : the official scientific journal of the Korean College of Neuropsychopharmacology] Poor phenotype quality and small cohorts remain major constraints in psychiatric biomarker research, and recent methodological advances increasingly address them. Language models turn clinical text into analysable variables at a scale manual chart review cannot reach. Self-supervised models learn from the unlabelled signals psychiatry already collects. Variant-effect prediction makes molecular interpretation computable, and research agents have generated and experimentally confirmed candidates outside psychiatry. These capabilities act early, on what is measured, what can be learned from it and which candidates are proposed. None of the artificial intelligence capabilities reviewed here yet reaches the stages at which a candidate becomes a clinical test. Producing candidates is becoming cheap while qualifying them is not. This review is organised around that asymmetry rather than by disorder or marker catalogue. It separates the measured characteristic, the prediction model and the intended clinical use, and treats method family as distinct from evidential stage. Across the selected evidence, discrimination is supported more strongly in development data than in independent evaluation, and prospective evidence that model-guided use improves care is scarce. Many reported metrics also address a simpler task than the intended decision: diagnosis instead of differential diagnosis, general prognosis instead of differential treatment benefit. The review proposes a six-stage framework linking intended use, measurement validity, model evaluation, comparative utility and monitored deployment, and places each capability on it, clarifying where methodological progress can accelerate discovery and where conventional clinical validation remains indispensable.

abstract: [Insights into imaging] To develop and validate a deep learning (DL)-based CT model integrating pancreatic imaging and CT-derived body composition for severity prediction in acute pancreatitis (AP). In this retrospective dual-center study, patients with AP who underwent CT within 72 h of symptom onset were enrolled from January 2021 to September 2025 at Center 1 and January 2023 to September 2024 at Center 2. The primary dataset (n = 426) was randomly divided into a training set (n = 298) and an internal test set (n = 128), while 110 patients from Center 2 served as the external test set. A three-dimensional DL model was developed for pancreatic imaging, and two-dimensional DL models were constructed for L3-level visceral adipose tissue (VAT) and skeletal muscle (SM). Six predictive models were constructed: clinical, pancreas, VAT, SM, pancreas-clinical (PC), and combined. Performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic analysis, DeLong testing, calibration, decision curve analysis, net reclassification improvement (NRI), and integrated discrimination improvement (IDI). The combined model achieved area under the curve (AUCs) of 0.897 (95% CI: 0.862-0.932), 0.909 (95% CI: 0.861-0.958), and 0.910 (95% CI: 0.856-0.964) in the training, internal test, and external test sets, respectively. The combined model outperformed the PC model in the training set (p = 0.002) and external test set (p = 0.020). NRI and IDI analyses confirmed the incremental predictive value of body composition features. A CT-based DL model integrating pancreatic imaging, body composition, and clinical variables demonstrated good performance for AP severity prediction. Question Early severity stratification in AP remains challenging because conventional clinical and imaging assessments may not fully capture pancreatic injury and systemic disease status. Findings A CT-based DL model integrating pancreatic imaging, body composition, and clinical variables demonstrated good performance for severity prediction in AP. Critical Relevance Statement This study evaluates the value of integrating pancreatic imaging and CT-derived body composition information and supports the use of routinely acquired CT data for early risk stratification, potentially facilitating more individualized monitoring and management of AP.

abstract: Elucidating the structures of unknown small molecules remains a major challenge in chemistry, pharmacology, and drug discovery. While nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy is the gold standard for structure elucidation, interpreting spectra remains labor-intensive and requires expert knowledge to navigate the vast space of possible structures. Here, we present an AI system for rapid, automated de novo structure elucidation that combines a molecular generative model with a scientific reasoning agent. Its generative component, ChefNMR2, is an atomic flow-matching model that predicts small-molecule structures from molecular formulae and one-dimensional 1H and 13C NMR spectra. ChefNMR2-Agent augments our generative model with large language models (LLMs) to reason over and refine candidate structures. Across diverse benchmarks, ChefNMR2 substantially outperforms existing tools, offering calibrated confidence estimates and two to three orders of magnitude faster inference than frontier LLMs. We use ChefNMR2-Agent to elucidate the structures of four novel natural products, matching human-chemist accuracy in a fraction of the time. Our work demonstrates how specialized generative models and general-purpose reasoning agents can unite to solve challenging scientific inverse problems and accelerate NMR structure elucidation, thus opening new possibilities for AI-driven small-molecule discovery across diverse disciplines.

abstract: [BMC ophthalmology] Cataracts remain a leading cause of reversible blindness, and artificial intelligence (AI) applications now span the cataract care pathway. However, the distribution of these applications and their validation maturity remain unclear. This review mapped AI across the care continuum, summarized task-specific performance, characterized validation maturity, and identified evidence gaps. The Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) was followed. PubMed, Scopus, the Cochrane Library, WorldCat, and the American Academy of Ophthalmology Meeting Archive were searched; the final search was completed on 20 July 2025. Eligible studies were English-language primary research published from 1 January 2020 through 20 July 2025. A review-specific cataract artificial intelligence clinical continuum (CAICC) evidence-mapping framework was developed during data charting and synthesis. Two reviewers independently conducted study selection, data extraction, endpoint adjudication, and validation-maturity assessment. Performance was summarized descriptively; validation maturity characterized evaluation independence and clinical stage, not risk of bias or overall methodological quality. Of 361 reports sought for retrieval, 122 (33.8%) were not retrieved; 113/122 (92.6%) were considered plausibly eligible from available metadata. The final synthesis included 185 studies: detection (n = 52), characterization (n = 50), personalized surgical planning (n = 27), intelligent surgery (n = 28), recovery (n = 24), and patient engagement (n = 4). Among 181 validation-applicable included studies, internal testing was the most frequent highest-maturity category (123/181, 68.0%), followed by external testing (33/181, 18.2%), prospective single-center evaluation (6/181, 3.3%), and prospective multicenter evaluation (2/181, 1.1%); 17/181 (9.4%) had no independent or unclear testing. Most included studies remained at internal validation stages, and prospective multicenter evaluation was rare. abstract: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo EM) relies on mature computational tools, but experts must still inspect intermediate results, choose among alternative processing routes, and decide when earlier choices should be revised. Here we present CryoPilot, a system of two language model agents that carries cryo-EM data from raw micrographs through three-dimensional reconstruction to validated atomic models. Rather than executing a predefined pipeline, its reconstruction agent evaluates intermediate images and quantitative diagnostics, selects and parameterizes CryoSPARC jobs, tests alternative strategies, compares their outcomes, and retains, revises, or reverts decisions accordingly. A persistent programming environment and session database preserve the complete processing history, making each decision traceable and allowing multi day workflows to proceed with minimal human intervention. Its modeling agent determines map handedness, builds atomic models with CryoZeta, removes regions the density does not support, and optimizes each model by testing refinement steps against map fit, geometry, and DAQ, a measure of local model to map agreement. Across nine public EMPIAR datasets, eight reconstructions reached 2.61 to 3.51 A resolution, and refined models from seven maps agreed with reference structures to within 0.4 to 4.9 A Calpha; RMSD. For a challenging alpha latrocrustotoxin dataset, a single change of particle picking strategy that we suggested enabled CryoPilot to improve the reconstruction from 5.9 to 4.15 A. CryoPilot establishes an adaptive and auditable framework for agent-driven cryo-EM structure determination.

abstract: [iScience] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being applied across the gastric cancer care continuum, but its clinical maturity differs substantially among endoscopy, cross-sectional imaging, digital pathology, prognostic modeling, treatment selection, and surgical support. Existing reviews have often focused on individual modalities or summarized algorithmic performance without systematically distinguishing technical feasibility from translational readiness. We conducted a structured narrative review of studies indexed in PubMed/MEDLINE and the Web of Science Core Collection from January 2022 through July 2026, supplemented by backward and forward citation tracking. Earlier landmark studies were retained when necessary to explain the development of major applications. Priority was given to prospective, multicenter, externally validated, and clinically actionable studies. Evidence maturity was assessed according to study design, validation breadth, workflow relevance, calibration and clinical-utility assessment, and implementation evidence. The main constraint on gastric cancer AI is no longer pattern-recognition capability but the absence of reproducible clinical benefit under real-world conditions. Priorities include multiregional prospective validation, standardized calibration and decision curve assessment, comparison of clinicians with and without AI, integration into existing workflows, evaluation of economic and patient-level outcomes, and post-deployment monitoring.

abstract: [The Journal of surgical research] The objective assessment of technical skill remains a significant challenge in surgical training and quality control. Intraoperative hemorrhage, a direct consequence of tissue handling, may serve as a quantifiable proxy for surgical proficiency. This study aims to develop and validate an artificial intelligence-derived metric based on intraoperative hemorrhage for objective skill assessment in laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Frames were sampled at 1 fps (every 25th frame) from videos recorded at 25 fps, and the 70 curated cases were split at the video (case) level into training, validation, and test sets (8:1:1; 56/7/7 videos). An external test set included 30 cases from Zhujiang Hospital. Hemorrhagic regions were manually annotated on 84,680 frames from 56 training videos. A PoolNet-based model quantified hemorrhagic pixels per frame during critical view of safety. Model outputs were validated against surgeon assessments (Fleiss' κ = 0.72) and operative metrics, with the modified Global Operative Assessment of Laparoscopic Skills (mGOALS) scale as the skill reference. Mean hemorrhagic pixels were correlated with skill scores, ratings, and maneuver frequencies. The hemorrhage identification model achieved dice scores of 0.819 ± 0.054 (internal) and 0.685 ± 0.031 (external). The proficiency metric negatively correlated with expert skill scores (Spearman's r = -0.93, P < 0.001), and strongly positively with subjective bleeding assessments (ρ = 0.89, P < 0.001) and hemostasis frequency (ρ = 0.94, P < 0.001). It effectively stratified surgeons by skill, with high-skill operators having fewer hemorrhagic pixels (Kruskal-Wallis H = 21.0-31.1, P < 0.001). The developed model provides an objective, automated hemorrhage metric that, in this preliminary validation, aligned with expert skill ratings and operative behavior during laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Pending difficulty-adjusted, multicentre validation, it may serve as a potential adjunct for postoperative, competency-based feedback rather than as a stand-alone measure of surgical skill.

abstract: [Journal of clinical epidemiology] Studies evaluating large language models in medicine increasingly follow a common design in which a fixed set of clinical questions is posed to several sources, such as different language models, clinicians, or patient-education resources. The responses are then scored for outcomes including accuracy, completeness, readability, or similar measures. Because each source answers the same set of questions, the resulting observations are inherently paired: the question functions as the repeated unit across sources. Despite this structure, many studies analyze the resulting data using statistical procedures that assume independent observations. Treating paired observations as independent introduces a mismatch between the study design and the statistical analysis. In evaluations where multiple sources respond to the same questions, the responses are naturally correlated because they are influenced by shared characteristics of the question, such as difficulty or ambiguity. Ignoring this dependence can reduce statistical power and distort the nominal type I error rate. These issues arise when commonly used independent-sample procedures, including the Mann-Whitney test, the Kruskal-Wallis test, one-way analysis of variance, or unpaired t-tests, are applied to datasets generated from identical question sets. The appropriate analytical framework instead treats the question as the unit of pairing. Methods designed for repeated or paired observations, such as the Friedman test or repeated-measures analysis of variance for overall comparisons, followed by paired contrasts using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test or paired t-tests with appropriate multiplicity correction, provide analyses that align with the underlying design. Effect sizes and regression approaches that account for the paired structure, including mixed-effects models with question treated as a random effect, may further strengthen inference. Recognizing the repeated-measures nature of these evaluations provides a straightforward path toward more statistically coherent analyses.
zh_abstract: 【摘要】评估大语言模型在医学中应用的研究日益遵循一种共同的设计：向多个来源（如不同的语言模型、临床医生或患者教育资源）提出同一组固定的临床问题，然后对回答的准确性、完整性、可读性或类似指标进行评分。由于每个来源回答的是同一组问题，所得观察值本质上是配对的：问题是跨来源的重复单位。尽管具有这种结构，许多研究仍使用假定观察值相互独立的统计方法分析这些数据。将配对观察值视为独立观察值，会造成研究设计与统计分析之间的不匹配。在多个来源回答相同问题的评估中，回答之间自然相关，因为它们受到问题共有特征（如难度或模糊性）的影响。忽略这种相关性会降低统计效能，并扭曲名义I类错误率。当常用的独立样本方法（包括Mann-Whitney检验、Kruskal-Wallis检验、单因素方差分析或非配对t检验）被应用于由相同问题集产生的数据时，就会出现这些问题。恰当的分析框架应将问题作为配对单位。针对重复测量或配对观察值设计的方法，例如用于总体比较的Friedman检验或重复测量方差分析，随后采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验或配对t检验进行配对对比并进行适当的多重性校正，可提供与基础设计相一致的分析。考虑配对结构的效应量和回归方法，包括将问题作为随机效应的混合效应模型，可进一步增强推断。认识到这些评估的重复测量性质，为获得在统计上更为一致的分析提供了一条直接的途径。

summary: RIF是基于图神经网络与伪标签半监督的空间转录组方法，可识别精细空间域并通过可解释性检测空间可变基因。
key_points: 图神经网络结合伪标签半监督，保持组织结构完整性
双预处理集成策略提升鲁棒性与泛化性
多平台上优于对比方法，并解析小鼠脑海马亚区
reason: 新方法有多平台基线对比，但为常规方法改进，属增量偏上档
abstract: [Cell reports methods] Spatial transcriptomics enables gene expression profiling with preserved spatial context, yet accurate spatial domain delineation remains challenging. We present RIF, a robust and interpretable deep learning framework for fine-grained spatial domain identification. RIF leverages graph neural networks semi-supervised with pseudo-labels to preserve tissue structural integrity. It incorporates a dual-preprocessing ensemble strategy to improve model robustness and generalization. It further enables spatially variable gene detection through network interpretability. Across multiple sequencing platforms, RIF outperformed state-of-the-art comparison algorithms in spatial domain identification. In mouse brain tissue, RIF identified corresponding hippocampal subfields in the spatially separated dorsal and ventral regions and resolved the laminar organization of the olfactory bulb. In breast cancer, RIF-defined domains suggest suppressed T cell activity associated with hypoxic and oxidative microenvironments. In an invasive ductal carcinoma dataset of more than 720,000 cells, RIF-defined domains suggest an epithelial-mesenchymal transition gradient, including reduced hormone dependence and extracellular matrix remodeling.
zh_abstract: 空间转录组学可在保留空间背景的情况下进行基因表达谱分析，但准确划分空间域仍具有挑战性。我们提出了RIF，这是一种用于精细空间域识别的稳健且可解释的深度学习框架。RIF利用以伪标签进行半监督的图神经网络来保持组织结构的完整性。它采用双重预处理集成策略以提高模型的稳健性和泛化能力，并进一步通过网络可解释性实现空间可变基因的检测。在多种测序平台上，RIF在空间域识别方面优于最先进的对比算法。在小鼠脑组织中，RIF在空间上分离的背侧和腹侧区域识别出相应的海马亚区，并解析了嗅球的分层组织。在乳腺癌中，RIF定义的空间域提示，与缺氧和氧化微环境相关的T细胞活性受到抑制。在包含超过72万个细胞的浸润性导管癌数据集中，RIF定义的空间域提示存在上皮–间质转化梯度，包括激素依赖性降低和细胞外基质重塑。

title: Parent Perceptions of Virtual and Artificial Intelligence Scribes at Pediatric Medical Visits.
zh_title: 家长对儿科门诊虚拟与AI书记员的看法
summary: 对11名儿科医生就诊的家长进行半结构化访谈，了解其对虚拟书记员的体验及对假设性AI书记员的态度。
key_points: 半结构化定性访谈
家长孩子年龄0至17岁
涉及美国中西部诊所系统
reason: 定性小样本研究，对AI书记员落地有一定参考，属增量档
abstract: [Applied clinical informatics] BACKGROUND: Scribes help physicians decrease electronic medical record documentation burden. There is transition from virtual to artificial intelligence (AI) scribes. A gap exists in our understanding of parent perspectives on technology-based scribe use at pediatric medical visits. OBJECTIVES: The objectives of this study were to explore parent perceptions of pediatric medical visits of lived experience with virtual scribe presence and consideration of hypothetical AI scribe use. METHODS: Semistructured qualitative interviews were conducted with parents of children aged 0 to 17 who visited 1 of 11 primary care pediatricians who worked with virtual scribes at a Midwestern clinic system. Parents were asked to reflect on visits with virtual scribe presence and their perceptions of hypothetical AI scribe use. Interviews were conducted by trained interviewers, recorded, and transcribed. Thematic analysis was applied to the transcripts using grounded theory and the constant comparative method. RESULTS: Interviews were completed by 33 parents, including 76% females, with a mean age of 40.30 years (standard deviation [SD] = 11.33). Two themes emerged regarding virtual scribe presence. First was that Parents felt heard, seen, and valued. Parents perceived greater focus and attention from the pediatrician. Second was Building trust in a third-party listener. Parents noted elements that built trust and overall low noticeability of scribe. Two themes emerged regarding hypothetical AI scribes. First was Valuing human information processing. Parents described concerns about AI accuracy and security and greater trust in human understanding. Second was AI as an Efficient workforce. Parents noted potential benefits for cost, reliability, and documentation. CONCLUSION: Parents described enhanced pediatrician connection at lived experience visits with virtual scribe presence. When considering hypothetical AI scribes, they perceived possible benefits but overall concerns for accuracy, security, and understanding. Studies of parents who experienced AI scribe presence at pediatric medical visits would be helpful to assess their perceptions of positive elements, benefits, and concerns.
zh_abstract:
【背景】抄写员（scribe）可帮助医生减轻电子病历书写负担。目前正从虚拟抄写员向人工智能（AI）抄写员过渡。对于家长如何看待儿科就诊中基于技术的抄写员的使用，我们的认识仍存在空白。
【目的】本研究旨在探讨家长对儿科就诊的看法，包括其亲身经历的虚拟抄写员在场的就诊体验，以及对假设性使用AI抄写员的考量。
【方法】对0至17岁儿童的家长进行半结构化定性访谈，这些儿童曾就诊于美国中西部某诊所系统中11名与虚拟抄写员合作的初级保健儿科医生之一。家长被要求回顾有虚拟抄写员在场的就诊，并谈谈对假设性使用AI抄写员的看法。访谈由经过培训的访谈员进行，并录音和转录。采用扎根理论和持续比较法对转录文本进行主题分析。
【结果】共33名家长完成访谈，其中女性占76%，平均年龄40.30岁（标准差[SD] = 11.33）。关于虚拟抄写员在场，出现两个主题。第一，家长感到被倾听、被关注和被重视：家长认为儿科医生更加专注和投入。第二，建立对第三方倾听者的信任：家长指出了建立信任的因素，以及抄写员总体上不易被察觉。关于假设性AI抄写员，出现两个主题。第一，重视人类的信息处理：家长对AI的准确性和安全性表示担忧，并对人类的理解更为信任。第二，AI作为高效的劳动力：家长指出其在成本、可靠性和文档记录方面的潜在益处。
【结论】家长描述，在有虚拟抄写员在场的亲身就诊经历中，与儿科医生的联系得到增强。在考虑假设性AI抄写员时，他们认为其可能带来益处，但总体上对准确性、安全性和理解能力存在担忧。若能开展针对在儿科就诊中亲身经历过AI抄写员在场的家长的研究，将有助于评估他们对其积极因素、益处和担忧的看法。

title: An interpretable multimodal deep learning model for physiological stress detection.
zh_title: 用于生理压力检测的可解释多模态深度学习模型
summary: 提出融合ECG、EDA与呼吸信号的可解释多模态深度学习框架，在受试者独立验证下准确率94.8%、AUC 0.97，优于单模态。
key_points: 融合ECG、EDA、呼吸信号，并结合传统特征模型
受试者独立验证准确率94.8%，单模态为86-91%
受试者依赖实验准确率达97.2%
reason: 小幅指标提升，多为公开数据式评估，缺外部验证与临床结局，属增量档
abstract: [PloS one] Stress is a major contributor to physical and mental health disorders, underscoring the need for reliable and interpretable detection systems. We present an interpretable multimodal deep learning framework that integrates electrocardiogram (ECG), electrodermal activity (EDA), and respiration signals using modality-specific neural architectures complemented by feature-based classical models. To ensure robustness and generalizability, the framework was evaluated under both subject-independent and subject-dependent protocols. Results show that multimodal fusion consistently outperformed single modalities, achieving 94.8% accuracy, 93.9% F1-score, and 0.97 AUC under subject-independent validation, compared with 86-91% accuracy for individual signals. In subject-dependent experiments, performance reached 97.2% accuracy and 96.8% F1-score. Comparative analysis with recent state-of-the-art methods demonstrated the competitiveness of our approach, while ablation studies confirmed the contribution of each modality and fusion strategy. Statistical significance testing with (p < 0.05) further validated the reliability of these gains. Importantly, interpretability analyses using Grad-CAM and attention visualization provided physiological insights, revealing that the model emphasizes clinically meaningful regions such as ECG R-peaks and phasic EDA fluctuations. By uniting high performance, robustness, and interpretability, this work advances stress detection research and offers a physiologically grounded framework for continuous mental health monitoring.
zh_abstract: [PloS one] 压力是导致身心健康障碍的主要因素，因此需要可靠且可解释的检测系统。我们提出了一种可解释的多模态深度学习框架，该框架采用针对各模态的神经网络架构，并辅以基于特征的经典模型，整合心电图（ECG）、皮肤电活动（EDA）和呼吸信号。为确保稳健性和泛化能力，该框架在受试者独立和受试者依赖两种评估方案下进行了评估。结果显示，多模态融合始终优于单一模态：在受试者独立验证中，准确率为94.8%，F1分数为93.9%，AUC为0.97，而单一信号的准确率为86%-91%。在受试者依赖实验中，准确率达到97.2%，F1分数为96.8%。与近期最先进方法的比较分析表明了本方法的竞争力，消融研究则证实了各模态及融合策略的贡献。以（p < 0.05）进行的统计显著性检验进一步验证了这些提升的可靠性。重要的是，使用Grad-CAM和注意力可视化进行的可解释性分析提供了生理学层面的见解，表明模型重点关注具有临床意义的区域，如ECG的R波峰和EDA的相位性波动。通过兼顾高性能、稳健性和可解释性，本研究推进了压力检测研究，并为持续的心理健康监测提供了一个具有生理学基础的框架。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Graph Methods for Microbiome Research: A Systematic Review.
zh_title: AI驱动的图方法用于微生物组研究：系统综述
summary: 系统综述微生物组研究中的图方法，从经典网络分析到图表示学习，并提出三类方法分类框架。
key_points: 梳理从经典网络分析到图表示学习的演进
提出三部分分类：网络表示、经典图分析、图表示学习应用
旨在整合碎片化的方法学格局
reason: 系统综述但领域较窄，未见纳入规模与明确结论，综述上限内偏低
abstract: [WIREs mechanisms of disease] The complexity of high-throughput sequencing data in microbiome research necessitates advanced analytical methods to decipher microbial community structures and interactions. Graph-based methods, which model taxa as nodes and their relationships as edges, have emerged as a powerful framework for this purpose. However, the rapid evolution of these techniques, from classical network analysis to modern graph representation learning, has created a fragmented and complex methodological landscape. This systematic review provides a comprehensive synthesis and structured overview of the field. We systematically review the literature and propose a three-part classification to categorize the primary contribution of each study: (1) novel methods for microbial network representation, (2) applications of classical graph analysis, and (3) the emerging use of graph representation learning for predictive modeling. We summarize the most frequent applications within each class, including keystone species identification, community clustering, and graph-based disease classification. Furthermore, we identify critical cross-cutting challenges, such as the lack of standardized tools and the need for improved model interpretability. By structuring the current landscape of graph-based methods, this review serves as a crucial guide for researchers to select appropriate models and highlights key gaps to direct future research.
zh_abstract: [WIREs mechanisms of disease] 微生物组研究中高通量测序数据的复杂性，需要先进的分析方法来解析微生物群落结构及其相互作用。以分类单元为节点、以其相互关系为边的基于图的方法，已成为实现这一目的的有力框架。然而，这些技术从经典网络分析到现代图表示学习的快速演进，造成了方法学格局的碎片化和复杂化。本系统综述对该领域进行了全面的综合并给出结构化概览。我们系统性地回顾了文献，并提出三部分分类法，以归类每项研究的主要贡献：（1）微生物网络表示的新方法，（2）经典图分析的应用，以及（3）图表示学习在预测建模中的新兴应用。我们总结了每一类中最常见的应用，包括关键物种识别、群落聚类和基于图的疾病分类。此外，我们还指出了关键的共性挑战，例如缺乏标准化工具以及需要提高模型可解释性。通过梳理基于图的方法的现状，本综述可为研究人员选择合适的模型提供重要指南，并指出关键空白以引导未来研究。

title: Machine learning and deep learning for diagnosis of endometriosis: systematic review and meta-analysis.
zh_title: 机器学习与深度学习诊断子宫内膜异位症：系统综述与荟萃分析
summary: 纳入22项研究的meta分析，ML/DL合并敏感度0.90、特异度0.75、SROC-AUC 0.92，提示可作为无创辅助诊断方向。
key_points: 遵循PRISMA，用QUADAS-2评估偏倚
多中心设计与DL与较低敏感度相关
作者呼吁开展大型多中心前瞻研究
reason: 纳入22项的meta分析，结论明确但异质性与证据级别有限
abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] To assess the diagnostic accuracy of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models for endometriosis. A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines (PROSPERO: CRD420251231469). Databases were searched through November 24, 2025. Twenty-two eligible studies were included. Risk of bias was assessed using QUADAS-2. Pooled analysis was conducted in Stata 18.0. Pooled sensitivity was 0.90 (95% CI 0.86-0.93), specificity 0.75 (95% CI 0.64-0.84), and SROC-AUC 0.92 (95% CI 0.89-0.94). A positive prediction increased disease probability from 10% to 29%, whereas a negative prediction reduced it to 1%. Multicenter design and DL were associated with lower sensitivity. Results were robust. ML/DL models demonstrate high diagnostic performance and are promising for non-invasive auxiliary diagnosis. Large multicenter prospective studies and multimodal models are needed to enable clinical translation.Systematic Review Registration: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251231469, identifier CRD420251231469.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 评估机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）模型对子宫内膜异位症的诊断准确性。按照 PRISMA 指南进行了系统评价和荟萃分析（PROSPERO：CRD420251231469）。检索截至 2025 年 11 月 24 日的数据库。共纳入 22 项符合条件的研究。采用 QUADAS-2 评估偏倚风险。使用 Stata 18.0 进行合并分析。合并敏感度为 0.90（95% CI 0.86-0.93），特异度为 0.75（95% CI 0.64-0.84），SROC-AUC 为 0.92（95% CI 0.89-0.94）。预测阳性使患病概率从 10% 升至 29%，而预测阴性则使其降至 1%。多中心设计和 DL 与较低的敏感度相关。结果稳健。ML/DL 模型表现出较高的诊断性能，有望用于无创辅助诊断。需要开展大规模多中心前瞻性研究和多模态模型，以实现临床转化。系统评价注册：https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251231469，标识符 CRD420251231469。

title: Artificial intelligence in image-guided cervical interventional radiotherapy: a systematic review.
zh_title: AI在影像引导宫颈近距离放疗中的系统综述
summary: 综述2010-2026年52项研究，涉及靶区与危及器官分割、计划、重建、配准及施源器选择，分割性能因结构而异。
key_points: 纳入52项研究，按PRISMA 2020
部分危及器官Dice接近或超过0.90
涵盖分割、计划、配准、施源器选择
reason: 纳入52项研究的系统综述，肿瘤影像方向，综述上限内
abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Imaging-guided interventional radiotherapy (IG-IRT) is the standard of care for locally advanced cervical cancer but remains time-consuming and operator-dependent. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising tool to improve efficiency and reproducibility. A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, searching PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science for studies published between 2010 and 2026 investigating AI-based imaging applications in cervical IRT. Eligible studies included original research evaluating segmentation (targets and organ at risk), planning, reconstruction, image registration and applicator selection. Fifty-two studies were included. Deep learning-based segmentation showed variable performance across anatomical structures and studies, with Dice coefficients approaching or exceeding 0.90 for some organs at risk and target volumes in the best-performing models. Individual studies reported shorter processing times, reduced contouring variability, accurate applicator reconstruction, and potential support for applicator selection. However, the substantial methodological and clinical heterogeneity precluded direct comparisons among AI approaches. The available studies suggest that AI may support the automation of selected workflow steps and assist treatment-related decision-making in image-guided cervical interventional radiotherapy. While several applications have achieved high technical performance, most remain at the proof-of-concept stage, and robust external validation and prospective clinical evaluation are needed before routine clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] 影像引导的近距离放疗（IG-IRT，即影像引导介入放疗）是局部晚期宫颈癌的标准治疗，但仍耗时且依赖操作者。人工智能（AI）已成为提高效率和可重复性的有前景工具。本系统评价按照 PRISMA 2020 指南进行，检索了 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science 中 2010 年至 2026 年间发表的、研究宫颈近距离放疗中基于人工智能的影像应用的文献。符合条件的研究包括评估分割（靶区和危及器官）、计划制定、重建、图像配准和施源器选择的原创研究。共纳入 52 项研究。基于深度学习的分割在不同解剖结构和不同研究之间表现不一，在表现最佳的模型中，部分危及器官和靶区的 Dice 系数接近或超过 0.90。个别研究报告了处理时间缩短、勾画变异性降低、施源器重建准确，以及对施源器选择的潜在支持。然而，方法学和临床上的显著异质性使得无法对各 AI 方法进行直接比较。现有研究提示，AI 可能支持影像引导宫颈近距离放疗中部分工作流程步骤的自动化，并辅助与治疗相关的决策。尽管若干应用已取得较高的技术性能，但多数仍处于概念验证阶段，在常规临床应用之前需要可靠的外部验证和前瞻性临床评估。

title: EMBER: Contextualized gene representations enable compositional prediction across cellular perturbations
zh_title: EMBER：用于扰动组合预测的情境化基因表示模型
summary: EMBER为以基因为中心的基础模型，在单细胞语料上结合相互作用引导对比学习与掩码表达重建预训练，编码器冻结后用轻量探针预测单/组合扰动效应。
key_points: 对比学习结合掩码表达重建预训练
编码器冻结，通过可组合嵌入接轻量探针
面向单一及组合扰动的预测
reason: 新颖单细胞基础模型预印本，摘要信息有限，未评审
abstract: Predicting the effects of individual and combined perturbations is central to identifying context-specific vulnerabilities and designing targeted interventions. Yet learning gene representations that integrate functional relationships with cellular state and transfer across perturbation tasks remains challenging. Here, we present EMBER, a gene-centric foundation model that learns context-dependent functional representations of genes. EMBER combines interaction-guided contrastive learning with masked expression reconstruction during pretraining on a single-cell corpus curated for diversity and balanced sampling across cell types and experimental batches. EMBER decouples gene representation learning from task-specific prediction through a composable embedding framework: the pretrained encoder remains frozen, while lightweight probes combine contextualized gene embeddings to predict individual and combined perturbation effects. The same pretrained representations support single-gene perturbation-response prediction, digenic interaction prediction, and multi-target drug-response prediction. EMBER improves cross-context perturbation-response prediction and genetic-interaction ranking relative to evaluated baselines. EMBER also prioritized SCFD1, a mediator of autophagosome-lysosome fusion, as a candidate dependency during mTOR inhibition. Together, these results establish contextualized gene embeddings as reusable building blocks for modeling genetic and pharmacological perturbations, supporting the prioritization of genetic interactions and context-specific interventions for experimental testing.
zh_abstract: 预测单一扰动和联合扰动的效应，对于识别特定情境下的脆弱性和设计靶向干预措施至关重要。然而，学习既整合功能关系又纳入细胞状态、并能在不同扰动任务间迁移的基因表征仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出 EMBER，一种以基因为中心的基础模型，可学习基因的情境依赖性功能表征。EMBER 在预训练阶段将相互作用引导的对比学习与掩码表达重建相结合，所用单细胞语料库经过精心整理，兼顾多样性，并在细胞类型和实验批次间进行平衡采样。EMBER 通过可组合的嵌入框架将基因表征学习与特定任务的预测解耦：预训练编码器保持冻结，而轻量级探针则组合情境化的基因嵌入来预测单一扰动和联合扰动的效应。同一预训练表征可支持单基因扰动响应预测、双基因相互作用预测以及多靶点药物响应预测。相较于所评估的基线方法，EMBER 改善了跨情境的扰动响应预测和遗传相互作用排序。EMBER 还将自噬体-溶酶体融合的介导因子 SCFD1 优先列为 mTOR 抑制过程中的候选依赖因子。总之，这些结果确立了情境化基因嵌入可作为可重复使用的构建模块，用于建模遗传和药理扰动，有助于对遗传相互作用和特定情境干预措施进行优先排序，以供实验检验。

abstract: [Current drug discovery technologies] Herbal medicines contain complex phytochemicals that offer therapeutic potential, but their long-term adverse effects remain challenging to determine. Traditional herbal medicine preparation methods are often labor-intensive, non-standardized, and face difficulties in identifying active ingredients. By improving medication development, optimization, and discovery procedures, Artificial Intelligence (AI) provides innovative ways to get beyond these restrictions. This systematic review aims to evaluate the role of AI-based software such as LEAFSNAP, Deep- Chem, PlantNet, Autodock, MestReNova, XCMS, ADMETlab, SynergyFinder, KEGG, TCMID, and Reactome in enhancing phytomedicine research by streamlining plant identification, bioactive compound discovery, molecular modeling, and pharmacokinetic profiling, thereby advancing drug discovery and development processes. A systematic review was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analysis (PRISMA guidelines) to explore the integration of AI-based tools in phytomedicine research and drug discovery. Literature searches were performed in Scopus, PubMed, and Google Scholar databases, focusing on studies published between January 2015 and January 2025. Only English-language articles focusing on AI-based software for drug discovery from plant-derived compounds were reviewed. Studies discussing synthetic drug development were excluded; this, along with non-English language, acted as a literature review limitation. Two reviewers independently screened the titles, abstracts, and full texts of the retrieved articles. Any discrepancies in the screening, study selection, and data extraction processes were resolved through discussion and consensus. Through the effective identification of bioactive chemicals and the simplification of intricate studies, the combination of artificial intelligence and computer tools has completely transformed the process of discovering and developing herbal drugs. Artificial intelligence tools like ADMETlab for pharmacokinetics and toxicity assessments, DeepChem for molecular activity modelling, and AlphaFold for protein structure prediction have greatly improved the search for new herbal drugs. While AutoDock improves molecular docking simulations by automating ligand-receptor binding predictions for bioactive chemicals, LeafSnap and PlantNet make plant identification simpler. Drug development workflows are improved by databases such as KEGG and TC

abstract: [Exploratory research in clinical and social pharmacy] Active pharmacovigilance in low-prevalence settings requires review of large electronic health record cohorts. We evaluated a pharmacist-supervised workflow combining electronic triggers with large language model (LLM)-assisted review. To assess candidate enrichment and stage-specific performance for adverse drug reaction (ADR) surveillance. In this retrospective cohort study, two pharmacists established a blinded reference standard for 7950 exposure episodes from 7950 unique inpatients. A prespecified Chinese Hospital Pharmacovigilance System trigger selected candidates for Qwen3-4B-Instruct and an institution-specific low-rank adaptation (LoRA)-fine-tuned model trained on 410 patient-disjoint cases involving other medicines. Paired errors were compared using exact McNemar tests. Twenty-eight episodes were ADR-positive. The trigger selected 167 candidates (2.10%), with 100.0% sensitivity (95% confidence interval, 87.66-100.0%) and 98.25% specificity. For the base versus LoRA-fine-tuned model, sensitivity was 82.14% versus 92.86%, specificity 88.49% versus 94.96%, positive predictive value 58.97% versus 78.79%, and F1 score 68.66% versus 85.25%. LoRA reduced false positives from 16 to 7 (9 corrected, 0 new; P = 0.0039). The numerical increase in sensitivity was not statistically significant (P = 0.250), with only 28 ADR-positive episodes available for evaluation. Trigger-first screening reduced review volume, while LoRA fine-tuning improved false-positive control. LLM classifications should support pharmacist review and should not be used as an autonomous exclusion rule.

abstract: [Environmental microbiology reports] Microbial ecosystems can now be measured across genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic, and environmental dimensions, yet their emergent functions remain difficult to predict and control. Artificial intelligence (AI) can integrate heterogeneous data, but predictive accuracy alone does not establish causality, transferability, or controllability. This review developed a five-layer framework: observe, infer, predict, design, and learn that connects microbial measurement to prospective intervention and experimental feedback. We critically synthesise evidence from sequence and protein learning, multi-omics integration, metabolic modelling, synthetic microbial communities, environmental biotechnology, and temporal forecasting. Recent primary studies illustrate progress in forecasting community trajectories, predicting microbial competition and designing consortia for pollutant degradation; they also reveal important boundaries between model performance and demonstrated ecosystem control. We examine risks arising from compositional data, information leakage, dependent observations, batch effects, uncertain calibration, sparse perturbation data, ecological instability, and evolutionary change. We propose operational criteria for ecosystem programmability and a staged validation pathway from controlled systems to field-relevant environments. Progress will depend on standardised context-rich data, hybrid AI-mechanistic models, prospective benchmarks, independent replication, and safety-constrained design.

abstract: [Frontiers in pharmacology] Respiratory RNA viruses remain a persistent threat because they combine high transmissibility, rapid evolution, immune escape, zoonotic spillover, and incomplete therapeutic coverage. RNA-dependent RNA polymerases (RdRps) and polymerase complexes are among the most conserved and pharmacologically actionable viral targets, yet they are also challenging computational targets because their ligandable states depend on RNA templates, cofactors, divalent metals, multidomain architecture, and conformational transitions. Artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), geometric deep learning (GDL), and generative molecular design are increasingly used to accelerate antiviral discovery, yet their performance is often inferred from general protein-ligand benchmarks dominated by non-viral targets. This review argues that respiratory RNA virus polymerases are a high-value but comparatively underrepresented class of antiviral targets and a complementary test case for evaluating AI-guided drug discovery. We synthesize current approaches in computer-aided drug design (CADD), molecular docking, ML-assisted virtual screening, molecular representations, pose-generation models, generative AI, and protein-ligand affinity benchmarking. We emphasize that docking scores, predicted affinity, and root-mean-square error (RMSE) values are insufficient unless linked to target engagement, enzymatic inhibition, cell-based antiviral activity, cytotoxicity, resistance, and pharmacological feasibility. We propose an RdRp-centered AI pipeline that integrates curated polymerase structural ensembles, leakage-resistant benchmarking, antiviral-specific evaluation tasks, ADME/Tox filtering, biochemical validation, cell-based infection assays, resistance profiling, and iterative model refinement. Moving beyond docking scores requires benchmarking models under virologically realistic conditions and validating whether computational prioritization enriches compounds with experimentally actionable antiviral activity.

abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] Medication errors and adverse drug events remain causes of patient harm, underscoring the need for technologies supporting medication identification, verification, and medication safety. Artificial intelligence (AI), computer vision, optical character recognition (OCR), and digital health technologies are applied to medication recognition. To systematically review AI-based medication recognition systems and characterize recognition tasks, computational approaches, datasets, evaluation, validation, generalizability, deployment, applications, and emerging directions. A systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020. Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore, and PubMed/MEDLINE were searched for publications from 1 January 2016 to 4 September 2026, using two conceptual blocks covering medication recognition and AI methods. Of 895 retrieved records, 136 duplicates were removed, and 759 records underwent screening. After full-text assessment, 14 reports were excluded, and 91 studies were included. Title-and-abstract screening yielded 84.72% observed agreement (Cohen's κ = 0.527 ). For methodological assessment, both reviewers independently applied D1-D8 to the 91 included studies before consensus resolution. Across 728 domain-level assessments, observed agreement was 97.66%, with an aggregate Cohen's κ of 0.959; domain-specific κ values ranged from 0.857 to 1.000. Evidence was synthesized through cross-study analysis and four evidence maps. Evidence shows use of detection, classification, OCR/imprint recognition, hybrid and multimodal architectures, alongside few-shot, low-shot, zero-shot, and incremental learning. Applications extend to assistive, mobile, and IoT-enabled systems, medication verification, and clinical decision support. Heterogeneity in datasets, imaging conditions, evaluation protocols, and validation strategies limits comparison and generalizability. External validation, cross-dataset testing, unseen-medication evaluation, prospective deployment, and clinical testing remain limited. AI-based medication recognition is evolving from a computer vision task into a digital informatics component supporting medication safety, accessibility, verification, and patient care. abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] Low vision is one of the major types of visual impairment worldwide and when diagnosed early can help with its management. Artificial intelligence (AI) has recently shown promising outcomes in all fields including health, with low vision rehabilitation being one of its significant applications. This systematic review aims to provide an up-to-date and comprehensive evaluation of the application of AI in the management of low vision. The systematic review followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines. All relevant published papers were retrieved through searches from PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and IEEE Xplore, without date restrictions. All retrieved articles from electronic databases were collated and managed in Covidence software. Nineteen studies were included, consisting of six application domains, which include assistive navigation and wayfinding (n = 8), environmental interaction and object recognition (n = 5), reading and text access (n = 2), educational accessibility (n = 1), medical applications (n = 3), and digital accessibility optimization (n = 1). Navigation systems demonstrated the strongest performance, with leading systems achieving sub-meter location error and 100% task success rates in real-world testing. Object recognition accuracies reached 97%, hazard detection achieved 92.0% dynamic accuracy with temporal filtering, and multimodal environmental understanding received risk assessment ratings of 9.40/10. Recurring technical limitations included sensitivity to lighting conditions, processing latency, and connectivity dependency. AI assistive technologies for low vision demonstrate technical feasibility with promising performance. However, important evidence gaps limit clinical application: the absence of prospective validation, limited comparative effectiveness data, and minimal patient-centered outcomes. Future studies should use standardized outcomes, larger and more diverse datasets, and longitudinal evaluations to demonstrate real-world impact. https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261324781, CRD420261324781.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] 低视力是全球视觉损害的主要类型之一，早期诊断有助于其管理。人工智能（AI）近来在包括医疗在内的各个领域均显示出良好前景，低视力康复是其重要应用之一。本系统评价旨在对人工智能在低视力管理中的应用提供最新、全面的评估。本系统评价遵循系统评价和荟萃分析优先报告条目（PRISMA）指南。通过检索 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science 和 IEEE Xplore（不限定日期）获取所有相关已发表论文。所有从电子数据库检索到的文章均在 Covidence 软件中整理和管理。共纳入 19 项研究，涵盖六个应用领域，包括辅助导航与寻路（n = 8）、环境交互与物体识别（n = 5）、阅读与文本获取（n = 2）、教育无障碍（n = 1）、医学应用（n = 3）以及数字无障碍优化（n = 1）。导航系统表现最为突出，领先系统在真实环境测试中实现了亚米级定位误差和 100% 的任务成功率。物体识别准确率达到 97%，结合时间滤波的危险检测动态准确率达到 92.0%，多模态环境理解的风险评估评分为 9.40/10。反复出现的技术局限包括对光照条件的敏感性、处理延迟以及对网络连接的依赖。面向低视力的人工智能辅助技术显示出技术可行性和良好的性能前景。然而，重要的证据缺口限制了其临床应用：缺乏前瞻性验证、比较有效性数据有限，以及以患者为中心的结局极少。未来研究应采用标准化结局指标、更大且更多样化的数据集以及纵向评估，以证明其在真实世界中的影响。https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261324781，CRD420261324781。

title: Deep learning-accelerated contrast-enhanced 3D MRI for acute optic neuritis: faster acquisition and improved lesion conspicuity.
zh_title: 深度学习加速增强3D MRI用于急性视神经炎：更快采集与更好病灶显示
summary: 前瞻性研究纳入59例疑似急性视神经炎患者，比较深度学习加速的T1-CUBE-DLS与标准T1-CUBE序列的成像质量与病灶显示。
key_points: 前瞻性纳入59例患者
两名盲法神经放射医师评分
以资深神经眼科医生诊断为参考标准
reason: 前瞻性但单中心小样本，属增量档，眼科影像略加分
abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] To compare a deep learning-accelerated contrast-enhanced 3D T1-weighted sequence (T1-CUBE-DLS) with standard parallel imaging-accelerated T1-CUBE for detecting acute optic neuritis (ON). This prospective study enrolled 59 patients with suspected acute ON (38 females; mean age 41.2 ± 12.8 years). All underwent contrast-enhanced whole-brain 3.0 T MRI including both T1-CUBE-DLS and standard T1-CUBE sequences. Two blinded neuroradiologists independently scored motion artifacts, subjective noise, and optic nerve clarity. Consensus readings recorded enhancement laterality, involved segments, and visual conspicuity. Enhancement length was measured per optic nerve, with inter-observer reliability assessed via intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) and Bland-Altman analysis. Clinical diagnosis by a senior neuro-ophthalmologist served as the reference standard. Acute ON was confirmed in 43 of 59 patients (72.9%). T1-CUBE-DLS reduced acquisition time by 36.2%. Subjective noise was equivalent between sequences (p > 0.05), but T1-CUBE-DLS showed significantly fewer motion artifacts and superior optic nerve clarity (both p 0.05). T1-CUBE-DLS demonstrated stronger visual conspicuity (p = 0.011) and slightly longer measured enhancement length (mean difference, 0.836 mm; p < 0.0001). ICC for length measurement was 0.91 for T1-CUBE-DLS vs. 0.83 for standard T1-CUBE, with narrower 95% limits of agreement (-1.37 to 1.51 mm vs. - 3.1 to 2.4 mm). T1-CUBE-DLS reduces acquisition time by 36.2%, with no significant difference in diagnostic accuracy detected, while improving enhancement conspicuity and measurement reproducibility, supporting its potential as a practical and efficient alternative for ON evaluation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in neurology] 比较深度学习加速的增强三维T1加权序列（T1-CUBE-DLS）与标准并行成像加速T1-CUBE在检测急性视神经炎（ON）中的表现。这项前瞻性研究纳入59例疑似急性ON患者（女性38例；平均年龄41.2 ± 12.8岁）。所有患者均接受包含T1-CUBE-DLS和标准T1-CUBE序列的3.0 T全脑增强MRI检查。两名盲法神经放射科医师独立对运动伪影、主观噪声和视神经清晰度进行评分。经共识阅片记录强化的侧别、受累节段及视觉显著性。对每条视神经测量强化长度，并通过组内相关系数（ICC）和Bland-Altman分析评估观察者间可靠性。以资深神经眼科医师的临床诊断作为参考标准。59例患者中有43例（72.9%）确诊为急性ON。T1-CUBE-DLS使采集时间缩短36.2%。两种序列的主观噪声相当（p > 0.05），但T1-CUBE-DLS的运动伪影显著更少，视神经清晰度更优（二者p均 0.05）。T1-CUBE-DLS显示出更强的视觉显著性（p = 0.011），测得的强化长度略长（平均差值0.836 mm；p < 0.0001）。长度测量的ICC：T1-CUBE-DLS为0.91，标准T1-CUBE为0.83；T1-CUBE-DLS的95%一致性界限更窄（-1.37至1.51 mm，对比-3.1至2.4 mm）。T1-CUBE-DLS使采集时间缩短36.2%，未检测到诊断准确性存在显著差异，同时提高了强化的显著性和测量的可重复性，提示其有望成为评估ON的实用且高效的替代方法。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Facelift Surgery: A Systematic Review of Objective Outcome Assessment and Patient-Perceived Rejuvenation.
zh_title: 面部提升手术中的人工智能：客观结局评估与患者感知的系统综述
summary: 系统综述纳入2020–2025年9项研究，评估CNN年龄估计、与患者感知的一致性及LLM辅助咨询，术后年龄下降1.7–5.8岁。
key_points: 纳入9项研究
CNN量化术后年龄下降1.7–5.8年
涵盖LLM患者咨询应用
reason: 小众领域系统综述，纳入研究少，属增量档
abstract: [Aesthetic plastic surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a tool for objective outcome assessment in facelift surgery (rhytidectomy), yet the clinical validity and limitations of these technologies remain incompletely characterized. This review evaluates the evidence on AI applications in facelift surgery, focusing on neural network based age estimation, concordance with patient perception, and large language model (LLM) supported patient counseling. A systematic review was conducted following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. Databases were searched for studies applying AI to facelift surgery with primary clinical data. Nine studies published between 2020 and 2025 met inclusion criteria. Convolutional neural networks quantified postoperative age reduction ranging from 1.7 to 5.8 years depending on surgical technique and follow-up interval. AI-derived estimates consistently underestimated patient-perceived rejuvenation by approximately 35% to 50%. Superficial musculoaponeurotic system-based techniques demonstrated greater AI-measured age reduction than skin-only procedures. LLMs achieved 85% to 88% diagnostic accuracy for patient counseling but exceeded recommended readability standards. AI enables objective quantification of facelift outcomes but demonstrates systematic discordance with patient perception. Current AI modalities should function as adjuncts to validated patient-reported outcome measures, not replacements. These preliminary findings warrant cautious interpretation given the limited and heterogeneous evidence base. Ethical concerns regarding algorithmic definitions of surgical success warrant consideration. This journal requires that authors assign a level of evidence to each article. For a full description of these Evidence-Based Medicine ratings, please refer to the Table of Contents or the online Instructions to Authors www.springer.com/00266 .
zh_abstract: [美容整形外科] 人工智能（AI）已成为面部提升手术（除皱术）客观结局评估的工具，但这些技术的临床有效性和局限性仍未被充分阐明。本综述评估了AI在面部提升手术中应用的证据，重点关注基于神经网络的年龄估计、与患者主观感受的一致性，以及大语言模型（LLM）支持的患者咨询。我们按照《系统评价和荟萃分析优选报告条目》指南进行了系统综述。检索数据库，纳入以原始临床数据将AI应用于面部提升手术的研究。共有9项发表于2020年至2025年的研究符合纳入标准。卷积神经网络量化的术后年龄减少幅度为1.7至5.8岁，取决于手术技术和随访间隔。AI得出的估计值持续低估患者自感的年轻化程度，低估幅度约为35%至50%。基于浅表肌肉腱膜系统的技术比仅处理皮肤的手术表现出更大的AI测得的年龄减少。LLM在患者咨询中的诊断准确率为85%至88%，但可读性超出推荐标准。AI能够对面部提升手术结局进行客观量化，但与患者感受存在系统性不一致。目前的AI方式应作为经过验证的患者报告结局指标的辅助手段，而不是替代品。鉴于证据基础有限且异质，这些初步发现应谨慎解读。关于算法对手术成功的定义的伦理问题值得考虑。本杂志要求作者为每篇文章指定证据等级。有关这些循证医学分级的完整说明，请参阅目录或在线作者须知 www.springer.com/00266 。

title: HER2 in solid tumors: microenvironment features and multifaceted advances from mechanisms to clinical translation.
zh_title: 实体瘤中的HER2：微环境特征与从机制到临床转化
summary: 综述HER2在实体瘤微环境中的作用、异质性与耐药，并提及多组学、液体活检与AI等技术进展。
key_points: HER2与免疫、基质相互作用塑造微环境
时空异质性影响诊断与靶向治疗持久性
多组学、液体活检和AI为应对手段
reason: 以肿瘤生物学为主的综述，AI仅为部分内容，属增量档
abstract: [Experimental hematology & oncology] Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) is a well-established oncogenic driver in multiple solid tumors, most prominently in breast and gastric cancers. Beyond gene amplification-driven signaling through canonical PI3K/AKT and RAS/MAPK pathways, emerging evidence reveals that HER2 functions within a highly dynamic and context-dependent tumor ecosystem. Interactions between HER2-positive tumor cells and immune and stromal compartments actively shape the tumor microenvironment, contributing to immune evasion, therapeutic resistance and disease progression. A central challenge in the clinical management of HER2-altered cancers is pronounced spatial and temporal heterogeneity, which undermines both diagnostic accuracy and the durability of targeted therapies. In response, advances in multi-omics profiling, liquid biopsy technologies and artificial intelligence-assisted analytics are redefining HER2 assessment, shifting it from static tissue-based classification towards dynamic, minimally invasive monitoring. In parallel, the therapeutic landscape has evolved from single-agent HER2 blockade to rational combination strategies. In particular, antibody-drug conjugates have emerged as a transformative modality, extending the therapeutic reach of HER2 targeting beyond traditional indications and offering new opportunities to overcome heterogeneity and drug resistance. This review synthesizes current insights into the molecular and microenvironmental biology of HER2-altered solid tumors and discusses how these advances are reshaping next-generation precision oncology.
zh_abstract: [Experimental hematology & oncology] 人表皮生长因子受体 2（HER2）是多种实体瘤（以乳腺癌和胃癌最为突出）中公认的致癌驱动因子。除基因扩增通过经典的 PI3K/AKT 和 RAS/MAPK 通路驱动信号传导外，新近证据表明，HER2 在一个高度动态且依赖于具体情境的肿瘤生态系统中发挥作用。HER2 阳性肿瘤细胞与免疫和基质成分之间的相互作用积极塑造肿瘤微环境，促进免疫逃逸、治疗耐药和疾病进展。HER2 改变型癌症临床管理的核心挑战是显著的空间和时间异质性，这削弱了诊断的准确性以及靶向治疗的持久性。对此，多组学分析、液体活检技术和人工智能辅助分析方面的进展正在重新定义 HER2 评估，使其从静态的基于组织的分类转向动态、微创的监测。与此同时，治疗格局已从单药 HER2 阻断发展为合理的联合策略。尤其是抗体偶联药物已成为一种变革性的治疗方式，将 HER2 靶向治疗的适用范围扩展到传统适应证之外，并为克服异质性和耐药性提供了新的机会。本综述归纳了目前对 HER2 改变型实体瘤分子生物学和微环境生物学的认识，并讨论了这些进展如何重塑下一代精准肿瘤学。

title: Artificial intelligence-supported revision of nursing care plans in a standardised newborn vignette: a one-group pretest-posttest study.
source: PubMed · Journal of research in nursing : JRN
zh_title: 生成式AI辅助修订护理计划：新生儿案例前后测研究
summary: 40名菲律宾护生在标准化新生儿案例中用AI辅助流程修订护理计划，盲评显示文档质量各维度均有提升。
key_points: 40名二年级护生，单组前后测
两名盲法护理教师评分
各维度质量提升，诊断表述增益最大
reason: 单组、小样本教育研究、无对照，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of research in nursing : JRN] Nursing students often produce care plans that are plausible yet generic, with weak linkage among diagnoses, interventions and outcomes. Teacher-mediated, bounded generative AI may support revision while preserving clinical judgement. To assess whether an AI-supported Reflect-Compare-Revise workflow improves nursing care plan quality and diagnosis-intervention-outcome alignment using a standardised newborn vignette. A one-group pretest-posttest study involved 40 second-year nursing students at a public university in the Philippines. Students wrote an unaided care plan, then revised it using the structured workflow. Two blinded nurse-educator raters scored paired plans using the Quality of Diagnoses, Interventions and Outcomes instrument. Post-revision documentation quality improved across all domains, with the largest raw gains in diagnostic formulation and nursing-sensitive outcomes. Interventions and outcomes remained the weaker downstream domains, with outcomes lowest at posttest. Diagnosis-intervention-outcome alignment and specificity increased, although explicit cross-linking remained inconsistent. This study adds preliminary evidence for nursing education: higher scores after guided AI-supported revision were associated with clearer and more coherent clinical reasoning in care planning. Policy recommendations are to permit bounded AI use with standardised prompts, revision logs/checklists, rubric-based feedback and verification safeguards to protect documentation integrity and patient safety.
zh_abstract: [Journal of research in nursing : JRN] 护理专业学生撰写的护理计划往往看似合理但内容泛泛，诊断、干预与结局之间的关联薄弱。由教师介导、有边界的生成式人工智能可能在保留临床判断的同时辅助修订。本研究旨在使用标准化新生儿案例，评估人工智能支持的“反思-比较-修订”（Reflect-Compare-Revise）工作流程是否能提高护理计划质量以及诊断-干预-结局的一致性。这项单组前后测研究纳入了菲律宾一所公立大学的 40 名二年级护理专业学生。学生先撰写无辅助的护理计划，然后使用结构化工作流程对其进行修订。两名设盲的护理教育者评分员使用“诊断、干预和结局质量”（Quality of Diagnoses, Interventions and Outcomes）量表对配对的计划进行评分。修订后，文书质量在所有维度上均有所提高，其中诊断表述和护理敏感结局的原始分增幅最大。干预和结局仍是较弱的下游维度，结局在后测时得分最低。诊断-干预-结局的一致性和具体性有所提高，但明确的相互关联仍不一致。本研究为护理教育提供了初步证据：在有指导的人工智能支持修订后得分更高，与护理计划中更清晰、更连贯的临床推理相关。政策建议是允许在有边界的前提下使用人工智能，配合标准化提示语、修订日志/核查清单、基于评分标准的反馈以及核实保障措施，以保护文书的完整性和患者安全。

title: Mechanistic gene-regulation-based trajectory inference with bowside
zh_title: bowside：基于基因调控机制的轨迹推断
summary: 提出浅层神经随机分化模型bowside，对基因调控进行机制建模，可同时推断单细胞分化轨迹并重建调控网络。
key_points: 同时完成轨迹推断与调控网络重建
在造血与iPSC重编程数据上演示
可找回已知命运决定网络模体
reason: 方法新颖的预印本，但摘要证据有限、未见对比
abstract: While single-cell RNA sequencing enables the in-depth study of differentiation processes, simultaneous trajectory inference and gene regulatory network reconstruction remain challenging. We propose bowside, a shallow neural stochastic differentiation model that mechanistically models gene regulation. Our method successfully recovers gene expression trends and the underlying regulatory interactions. We demonstrate bowside on hematopoiesis and induced pluripotent stem cell reprogramming data, retrieving known fate-determining network motifs.
zh_abstract: 虽然单细胞RNA测序使得对分化过程的深入研究成为可能，但同时进行轨迹推断和基因调控网络重建仍具挑战性。我们提出了bowside，这是一种浅层神经随机分化模型，可对基因调控进行机制性建模。我们的方法成功恢复了基因表达趋势及其潜在的调控相互作用。我们在造血和诱导多能干细胞重编程数据上展示了bowside，检索出已知的决定细胞命运的网络基序。

title: Task-Dependent Performance of GNNs and Pretrained Models in ADMET Prediction
zh_title: ADMET预测中GNN与预训练模型的任务依赖表现
summary: 在六个TDC ADMET终点上以骨架划分，对GNN、冻结预训练模型和指纹基线做匹配调参预算的公平比较。
key_points: 各模型统一50次验证选择的调参预算
报告十个随机种子的中位数
仅用验证集选架构与超参
reason: 设计规范的基准比较，但为预印本且增量有限
abstract: Structure-based prediction of ADMET (absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity) properties promises fast, low-cost screening of drug candidates, yet model selection remains unclear because published comparisons of molecular representations often use unmatched tuning budgets and leakage-prone evaluation protocols, producing performance differences that may not reflect model quality. To address this gap, we benchmark graph neural networks (GNNs), frozen pretrained models (ChemBERTa, MolCLR), and fingerprint baselines across six Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET endpoints under scaffold-split evaluation. To make it really fair we gave every model family a matched 50-trial, validation-selected tuning budget and reported the median over ten seeds; architecture and hyperparameter selection use validation data only, with the held-out test split reserved for final performance estimation. Under this fair comparison protocol, emph{no model family dominates} and the differences between families fall within the seed-to-seed range on most endpoints. The GNN is clearly best only on Caco-2 permeability (R$^2 approx 0.48$), and a controlled ablation shows this advantage comes entirely from auxiliary physicochemical descriptors rather than the graph representation; Morgan fingerprints are competitive on hERG (AUC $approx 0.77$) and give the best median on both clearance endpoints, while MolCLR is best on Tox21. For hepatocyte clearance and half-life, all models yield near-zero or negative R$^2$. No single hyperparameter-optimization strategy, among seven evaluated, consistently outperforms random search at this budget, and we show that selecting the optimizer using test-set performance or reporting only single best-trial runs can substantially inflate a favored model's apparent advantage. Reliable ADMET modeling therefore requires endpoint-specific model selection together with fair, leakage-controlled, seed-averaged evaluation, offering more trustworthy decision support for early-stage drug candidate prioritization.
zh_abstract: 基于结构的ADMET（吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性）性质预测有望实现快速、低成本的候选药物筛选，但模型选择仍不明确，因为已发表的分子表示比较常采用不匹配的调参预算和易发生数据泄漏的评估方案，导致的性能差异可能并不反映模型的真实质量。为弥补这一不足，我们在骨架划分评估下，针对六个Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET终点，对图神经网络（GNN）、冻结的预训练模型（ChemBERTa、MolCLR）和指纹基线进行了基准测试。为确保真正公平，我们为每个模型家族提供了匹配的、经验证集选择的50次试验调参预算，并报告十个随机种子的中位数；架构和超参数的选择仅使用验证数据，保留的测试集仅用于最终性能估计。在这一公平比较方案下，没有任何模型家族占据主导地位，在大多数终点上，各家族之间的差异落在不同随机种子之间的波动范围内。GNN仅在Caco-2渗透性上明显最优（R$^2 \approx 0.48$），而对照消融实验表明，这一优势完全来自辅助的理化描述符，而非图表示；Morgan指纹在hERG上具有竞争力（AUC $\approx 0.77$），并在两个清除率终点上给出最佳中位数，而MolCLR在Tox21上最优。对于肝细胞清除率和半衰期，所有模型的R$^2$均接近零或为负。在所评估的七种超参数优化策略中，没有任何一种在此预算下始终优于随机搜索；我们还表明，使用测试集性能来选择优化器，或仅报告单次最佳试验的结果，会显著夸大某个受偏爱模型的表观优势。因此，可靠的ADMET建模需要针对具体终点选择模型，并配合公平、控制数据泄漏、按随机种子平均的评估，从而为早期候选药物的优先排序提供更可信的决策支持。

title: Attitudes and perceptions toward artificial intelligence among practicing rheumatologists in Iraq: a cross-sectional web-based survey.
zh_title: 伊拉克风湿科医生对人工智能的态度：横断面调查
summary: 2025年10月至2026年1月开展网络问卷调查，评估伊拉克执业风湿科医生对AI的态度及其与人口学、职业特征的关联。
key_points: 四个月网络横断面调查
问卷经专家审阅与预试验

reason: 区域性问卷调查，无技术或临床结局，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Artificial intelligence is becoming a bigger part of healthcare, particularly in rheumatology, where clinicians must integrate complex clinical, laboratory, and imaging data. Physicians' perceptions of AI may substantially influence the extent to which it is implemented responsibly in routine clinical practice. This study aimed to assess the attitudes of practicing rheumatologists in Iraq toward artificial intelligence and to examine their association with demographic and professional characteristics. A four-month web-based cross-sectional survey was conducted from October 2025 to January 2026. A questionnaire adapted from previous studies was refined through expert review and pilot testing before distribution. The questionnaire comprised demographic information, attitude statements measured on a five-point Likert scale, and items assessing general perceptions of artificial intelligence. Composite attitude scores were categorized using modified Bloom's cutoff criteria. Statistical analysis was performed using SPSS and R. A total of 162 complete responses were collected. Most respondents were aged 35-44 years (42.0%), male (56.8%), and specialists (67.9%). Overall, 61.7% reported familiarity with AI and 69.1% had already used AI in rheumatology practice. Most participants 56.8% exhibited a poor attitude, 32.1% a moderate attitude, and 11.1% a good attitude toward AI. Bivariate analysis identified familiarity with AI ( p = 0.003 ) and involvement in research ( p = 0.009 ) as significantly associated with more favorable attitudes. Iraqi rheumatologists demonstrate cautious engagement with artificial intelligence, with the majority displaying poor-to-moderate overall attitude scores on the standardized composite scale. Greater familiarity with AI and research involvement were associated with more favorable attitudes, highlighting the importance of targeted digital literacy and specialty-specific education to support effective AI adoption in clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 人工智能在医疗保健中的地位日益重要，尤其是在风湿病学领域，临床医生必须整合复杂的临床、实验室和影像数据。医生对人工智能的看法可能在很大程度上影响其在常规临床实践中被负责任地应用的程度。本研究旨在评估伊拉克执业风湿病医生对人工智能的态度，并探讨其与人口统计学和职业特征的关联。2025年10月至2026年1月开展了为期四个月的网络横断面调查。改编自既往研究的问卷经专家评审和预试验完善后发放。问卷包括人口统计学信息、采用五点李克特量表测量的态度陈述，以及评估对人工智能总体看法的条目。综合态度得分采用改良Bloom临界标准进行分类。使用SPSS和R进行统计分析。共收集到162份完整问卷。大多数受访者年龄为35-44岁（42.0%）、男性（56.8%）、专科医生（67.9%）。总体上，61.7%报告熟悉人工智能，69.1%已在风湿病学实践中使用过人工智能。多数参与者（56.8%）对人工智能态度较差，32.1%态度中等，11.1%态度良好。双变量分析发现，熟悉人工智能（p = 0.003）和参与研究（p = 0.009）与更积极的态度显著相关。伊拉克风湿病医生对人工智能的参与持谨慎态度，在标准化综合量表上，大多数人的总体态度得分为较差至中等。对人工智能更熟悉和参与研究与更积极的态度相关，这凸显了开展有针对性的数字素养和专科特定教育对支持人工智能在临床实践中有效应用的重要性。

title: Artificial intelligence in health insurance fraud detection: a global and regional systematic review.
zh_title: AI用于医保欺诈检测的全球与区域系统综述
summary: 按PRISMA 2020检索2016-2025年文献，综述AI在医保欺诈检测中的方法、性能评估与落地挑战。
key_points: 检索七个数据库，覆盖2016-2025年
关注方法路径、性能评价与实施挑战
采用Silvi AI平台辅助筛选
